mechanism: Regime-dependent sign of completed H1 serial autocorrelation; compare an ex-ante causal momentum-versus-reversal switch to always-on H1 momentum and zero trade. No closed predictor/model is imported or retuned.
predictor: At completed H1 clock compute lag-1 serial correlation from 20 earlier complete H1 returns. If rho>+0.20 forecast last H1 return side; if rho<-0.20 forecast opposite side; otherwise abstain. Fixed 60-minute delayed-following-M5 outcome. No peeking beyond complete clocks.
benchmark: Always-on previous completed H1 return sign at all causally eligible clocks, plus zero trade. Not a matched-clock same-direction straw benchmark.
